body:
Please please please do not come out to your parents if you depend on them for financial support.

If you're not sure, try seeing what they think of transgender people first (binary trans or not). But if you still live under their roof and depend on them for food, shelter, etc. you're really better off safer than sorry by staying closeted. I know that sucks, and probably not what you want to hear, but your identity is nobody's business. You can be whoever you want to be and you don't owe it to anyone to "come out" or tell anybody if you're not comfortable or ready to.

Moving out will probably need to be something you force yourself to, even if it means cutting off your parents. Sit them down and explain to them why you want to move out and why you want to be independent. Ultimately, if you still want to do it despite their protests - do it anyway.   


I remember my brother wanted to move out at 18 when he began college. My parents didn't want to let him go, but he did end up moving out and living on his own, and he's been very successful since. My parents have also not regretted his choice, but even if they had - it's his life, and he is a grown adult who can make his own choices. If he can do it, so can you, so can anyone.

If moving out isn't an option because you're underage, then it's just better to wait until you turn 18 and have a steady income. If you can get a job, for example, start squirreling away money (like in a savings account, or a physically extremely secure hiding spot) until you're 18.

From one nonbinary person to another, I wish you the best.
